title: IS2020 Competency Model
description: ACM/AIS joint model curriculum for undergraduate IS programs. Competency-based approach across 19 competency areas, replacing IS2010.

title: MSIS 2016 — Global Competency Model for Graduate IS Programs
description: Global competency model for graduate degree programs in IS. Profiles include IT consultant, project manager, analytics specialist, and start-up entrepreneur.

title: CC2020 — Computing Curricula 2020
description: ACM/IEEE meta-report covering all computing disciplines (CS, IS, IT, SE, CE). Provides competency framework and cross-discipline comparison.

title: NICE Cybersecurity Workforce Framework
description: NIST framework establishing common language for cybersecurity work roles, knowledge, and skills. Widely used for curriculum alignment and accreditation.

title: AIS Education Page
description: Central education hub of the Association for Information Systems with links to educational initiatives, task forces, and resources.

title: AIS MaCuDE Task Force
description: AIS Master's Curriculum and Degree Enhancement Task Force. Focuses on advancing IS graduate education globally.

title: Harvard Business Publishing Education — Cases
description: Thousands of business and IS cases with teaching notes. Faculty get free evaluation access. The gold standard for case-based teaching.

title: Ivey Publishing — IS/IT Case Collection
description: Over 23,000 cases with a dedicated Business Information Systems collection. Global perspective, also distributes cases from external authors.

title: The Case Centre
description: World's largest repository of management teaching cases (500+ member institutions). Includes free cases from Stanford and MIT Sloan.

title: Journal of IT Teaching Cases (JITTC)
description: Peer-reviewed IS/IT teaching cases published by SAGE, covering strategy, emerging tech, business models, and system implementation.

title: JITCAR — Journal of IT Case and Application Research
description: Case-based research on IT/IS applications in organizations. Covers AI, ERP, e-commerce, security, and more.

title: JISE Teaching Cases
description: Teaching cases published in the Journal of Information Systems Education, with teaching notes available to instructors.

title: MIT Sloan LearningEdge
description: Free teaching case studies and management flight simulations from MIT Sloan faculty. Includes teaching notes and videos.

title: Open Access Teaching Case Journal (OATCJ)
description: Open-access teaching cases distributed through The Case Centre. Free to access.

title: OpenStax: Foundations of Information Systems
description: Free, peer-reviewed IS textbook (CC BY-NC-SA) aligned with IS2020/ABET/AACSB standards. Covers hardware, software, databases, networks, AI, analytics, and security.

title: Open Textbook Library — Information Systems
description: Catalog of open IS textbooks, faculty-reviewed. Free to use, distribute, and adapt.

title: MERLOT
description: 100,000+ peer-reviewed OER materials across disciplines including Business/IS. International community of 197,000+ members.

title: OER Commons
description: Digital library with 500+ content partners. Search by discipline, level, and media format. Includes IS and cybersecurity materials.

title: MIT OpenCourseWare
description: Complete course materials (lectures, assignments, exams) for database systems, systems integration, and related IS courses. Fully downloadable.

title: AISEL Teaching Resources
description: Open-access teaching resources in the AIS Electronic Library, contributed by IS educators worldwide.

title: SAP University Alliances
description: Free access to SAP systems, academic lesson plans, SAP Learning Hub (student edition), and ERPsim integration. 500+ member institutions.

title: Oracle Academy
description: Free institutional membership with curriculum for Java, databases, cloud, and ERP. Includes Oracle Cloud Free Tier access and professional development.

title: AWS Academy
description: Free ready-to-teach cloud computing and AI/ML curriculum for accredited institutions. Includes AWS Learner Lab sandboxes and certification prep.

title: Microsoft Learn for Educators (MSLE)
description: Free courseware, lab environments, faculty notes, and certification vouchers for Azure, AI, security, and dev tools.

title: Tableau Academic Programs
description: Free Tableau Desktop and Prep Builder licenses for educators and students. Includes teaching curriculum for data visualization courses.

title: Salesforce Trailhead
description: Free gamified learning platform covering CRM, data literacy, AI, and business process automation. Modular trails and badges for class integration.

title: Google Grow with AI for Educators
description: Free AI skills course for educators covering how to save time, personalize instruction, and enhance lessons with AI.

title: CompTIA Academic Partner Program
description: Academic pricing on certifications (A+, Security+, Network+), free curriculum resources, and CertMaster learning tools.

title: ERPsim (HEC Montreal / Baton Simulations)
description: Business simulation on real SAP S/4HANA. Three difficulty levels. Adopted by 100+ universities. The leading ERP simulation platform for IS courses.

title: MonsoonSIM
description: AI-powered experiential learning platform with business simulations covering ERP, supply chain, finance, and HR. 183,000+ users across 349+ institutions.

title: Capsim
description: Business strategy simulations widely used in capstone IS/business courses. 1.7M+ student users at hundreds of business schools.

title: CaseIT Competition
description: World's premier undergraduate MIS case competition hosted by SFU. Source of high-quality IS case problems and student engagement model.

title: AIS SIGED — SIG on Education
description: AIS Special Interest Group on Education. Organizes ICISER (pre-ICIS workshop), education tracks at ECIS/AMCIS, career mentoring, and the IS Student Research Journal.

title: SIGCITE — ACM SIG on Cybersecurity & IT Education
description: ACM Special Interest Group on Cybersecurity & IT Education. 400+ members. Created model IT undergraduate curriculum and accreditation guidelines.

title: EDSIG / ISCAP
description: Education SIG / Information Systems & Computing Academic Professionals. Annual conference with IS pedagogy, cybersecurity, and data analytics tracks.

title: EDUCAUSE
description: Leading association for IT in higher education. Publishes EDUCAUSE Review, digital transformation frameworks, and AI landscape studies.

title: ISACA Academic Programs
description: Professional association for IT governance/audit/security. Certifications (CISA, CISM, CRISC) map to IS curriculum.

title: Journal of Information Systems Education (JISE)
description: Premier diamond open-access journal on IS education. Publishes teaching tips, cases, curriculum design, and pedagogy research. No fees.

title: Information Systems Education Journal (ISEDJ)
description: Peer-reviewed journal by ISCAP/EDSIG focusing on IS education research, curriculum, and pedagogy.

title: AOM IM Division — Teaching Resources
description: Academy of Management's Information & Operations Management Division teaching resources for management and IS educators.

title: AOM MED Division — Resource Spotlight
description: Academy of Management's Management Education Division library highlighting teaching and learning resources.

title: AMR Teaching Resources
description: Academy of Management Review teaching resources — guidance on using AMR articles in the classroom.

title: Coursera — IS Courses
description: Hundreds of IS, cybersecurity, and data analytics courses from top universities. Includes professional certificates. Many free to audit.

title: edX
description: Courses, certificates, and degrees from MIT, Harvard, and others in IT, cybersecurity, data science, and business management.

title: Kaggle — Datasets & Courses
description: Open datasets for data science and ML projects, plus free micro-courses. Useful for hands-on IS analytics and data management assignments.

title: AI Goes to College
description: Resources and community around integrating artificial intelligence into college curricula and teaching practices.

title: Harvard: Teach with Generative AI
description: Practical resources on using LLMs in teaching: simulating personas, personalizing feedback, generating assignments, and creating course-specific chatbots.

title: Cornell CTI: Generative AI in Teaching
description: Faculty support resources on academic integrity, ethical AI use, accessibility, and research on GenAI impacts on student learning.

title: OECD Digital Education Outlook
description: Evidence-based examination of how GenAI reshapes education. Covers intelligent tutoring, risks of metacognitive laziness, and pedagogical design.

title: Faculty Focus
description: Regular articles on designing AI-powered classrooms, emerging learning trends, and modern pedagogical approaches.

title: NICCS — National Initiative for Cybersecurity Careers and Studies
description: CISA's portal with NICE Framework work roles, education provider search, and free cybersecurity training catalog.

title: AIS Electronic Library (AISeL)
description: Open-access archive of proceedings from ICIS, AMCIS, ECIS, PACIS, and all AIS-affiliated conferences and journals.

title: Pearson MyLab MIS (Laudon)
description: Companion platform for Laudon's MIS textbook with Learning Tracks, Dynamic Study Modules, test banks, and video cases.

title: McGraw Hill Connect — MIS
description: MIS digital courseware with SmartBook AI reader, LMS integration, and real-time student insights.

title: GitHub Education (Campus Program, Classroom & Student Developer Pack)
description: Free GitHub Enterprise access for institutions, GitHub Classroom for distributing code assignments with auto-grading, and the Student Developer Pack with 100+ tool offers. Campus Experts program trains student community leaders.

title: IBM SkillsBuild for Academia
description: Free platform with 1,000+ online courses, digital credentials, hands-on labs, and faculty training in AI, data science, cybersecurity, and cloud. Includes guest lectures and group innovation challenges for universities.

title: Cisco Networking Academy
description: Free self-paced courses in networking, cybersecurity, Python, AI, and data analytics. Includes Packet Tracer simulation tool, CCNA certification prep, and alignment with NICE/CSTA standards. Millions of students worldwide.

title: SAP Signavio Academic Edition (BPM Academic Initiative)
description: Free access to SAP Signavio process modeling and simulation for students and faculty. Supports BPMN 2.0 modeling, process simulation, and dictionary items. Six-month renewable licenses with institutional email.

title: SAP Learning — Student Edition & Free Courses
description: Free SAP Learning Hub Student Edition with full course content, interactive modules, cloud-based practice systems, and two free SAP certification attempts. Over 100 former openSAP courses available as free self-paced learning.

title: Google Cloud for Education
description: Free Google Cloud credits for faculty and students, Google Cloud Skills Boost with hands-on labs and skill badges, and Google Cloud Certificates. Faculty may receive up to 5,000 skills credits for classroom distribution.

title: SAS Academic Programs
description: Free SAS OnDemand for Academics (cloud-based SAS access) and SAS Viya for Learners. Includes 15+ free e-learning courses, certification exam prep, curriculum support workshops, and campus course materials for analytics education.

title: JetBrains Educational Licenses
description: Free access to all JetBrains IDEs (IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, etc.) for students and faculty. Individual licenses via university email or ISIC card; institutional classroom licenses also available free. Renewable annually.

title: Celonis Academic Alliance
description: Free access to Celonis process mining platform for 700+ partner universities. 400+ hours of free content, digital badges, and the STaR thesis support program. Over 400,000 students trained in 50+ countries.

title: Teradata University Network (TUN)
description: Free web portal for teaching database, data warehousing, and BI. Includes syllabi, software access, PowerPoint decks with notes, cases with teaching notes, and large corporate datasets. Academic-governed; 45,000+ student users across 72 countries.

title: MongoDB University & Educator Center
description: Free self-paced courses on NoSQL, data modeling, aggregation, and Atlas. MongoDB for Educators program provides free certification vouchers. Student benefits available via GitHub Student Developer Pack.

title: Scrum.org University Partner Program
description: Partner universities integrate Professional Scrum education into degree programs using the Scrum Guide and Scrum.org resources. Students can earn Scrum.org certifications as part of their coursework.

title: PMI Academic Programs & Curriculum Resources
description: Free curriculum and teaching resources for project management courses, including Foundations course materials, case studies, and desk copies. PMI Global Accreditation Center accredits 205+ PM degree programs worldwide.

title: Cisco Packet Tracer
description: Free cross-platform network simulation tool for designing and testing network topologies. Supports routing, switching, VLANs, and IoT. Activity Wizard enables instructors to create custom practical assignments. No hardware required.

title: GNS3 — Graphical Network Simulator
description: Free open-source network emulation platform running actual network operating systems (Cisco IOS, JunOS). 800,000+ member community. Supports multi-vendor environments for CCNA/CCIE certification prep and enterprise network design labs.

title: Marketplace Simulations
description: Over 30 marketing and business simulations for undergraduate through MBA courses. Covers marketing strategy, entrepreneurship, operations, and supply chain. 1.3M+ students. AACSB assessment tools included.

title: Forio Simulations (Harvard, MIT, Wharton)
description: Online business simulations developed with Harvard, MIT, and Wharton faculty. Includes the MIT Beer Game (supply chain), Harvard Everest (leadership), Design Thinking (food truck), and Change Management simulations. Used by 60%+ of MBAs worldwide.

title: ProM — Process Mining Framework
description: Open-source (GPL) process mining toolkit from Eindhoven University of Technology. Extensible plug-in architecture for process discovery, conformance checking, and enhancement. Free online course with 15,000+ enrolled students.

title: Internationale Tagung Wirtschaftsinformatik (WI Conference)
description: The premier research conference for the German-speaking IS (Wirtschaftsinformatik) community, organized jointly by WKWI and GI Fachbereich WI. Held annually since 2019, replacing the former WI/MKWI alternating schedule.

title: Business & Information Systems Engineering (BISE / WIRTSCHAFTSINFORMATIK)
description: Flagship journal of the German-speaking IS community for 60+ years. Bilingual (English in BISE, German in WIRTSCHAFTSINFORMATIK). AIS-affiliated, Springer-published. Strong design science focus. Sponsored by WKWI and GI-FB WI (1,200+ members).

title: IRIS Association & SCIS Conference (Scandinavian Chapter of AIS)
description: The oldest consecutive IS conference in the world (since 1978). IRIS is a working seminar with 45-60 min group discussions per paper; SCIS is the formal proceedings conference. Manages the Scandinavian Journal of Information Systems (SJIS).

title: Scandinavian Journal of Information Systems (SJIS)
description: Official AIS-affiliated journal of the IRIS Association, free on AISeL. Emphasizes participatory research, design science, and Nordic IS traditions. Published since 1989; two issues per year.

title: NOKOBIT — Norwegian Conference for Organizations' Use of IT
description: Annual Norwegian conference (32+ years) on ICT in organizations and society, part of the broader NIKT conference. Accepts papers in Norwegian, Scandinavian languages, or English. Level 1 in the Norwegian scientific register.

title: AIM — Association Information et Management (French IS Community)
description: Founded in 1991, AIM is the primary academic association for the francophone IS community and an AIS affiliated chapter. Organizes annual French-speaking conferences, workshops, and promotes IS training programs in French-speaking countries.

title: ItAIS — Italian Chapter of AIS
description: Founded in 2003, ItAIS brings together the Italian IS community with annual conferences, SIGs covering epistemology, design methodologies, e-government, and IS education. Proceedings available on AISeL.

title: MCIS — Mediterranean Conference on Information Systems
description: AIS-affiliated conference focusing on IS research relevant to the Mediterranean region's social, economic, and cultural context. Proceedings on AISeL. Sometimes held jointly with MENACIS or ItAIS.

title: AAIS — Australasian Association for Information Systems
description: AIS Region 3 chapter representing 19 countries in Australia, NZ, and Oceania. Organizes the annual ACIS conference (since 1990) and publishes the Australasian Journal of Information Systems (AJIS). AIS Outstanding Chapter 2023.

title: Australasian Journal of Information Systems (AJIS)
description: Diamond open-access journal (no fees for authors or readers) published by AAIS since 1993. ABDC A-ranked, SJR Q1 in Business Management. Covers IS research with emphasis on Australasia and Asia-Pacific.

title: INAIS — AIS India Chapter
description: Founded 2016; won AIS best chapter award four consecutive years (2019-2022). Organizes InCIS (India Conference on Information Systems), research method workshops, and webinars with IIMs and top Indian institutions.

title: MENA-AIS Chapter & MENACIS Conference
description: AIS chapter for the Middle East and North Africa region. Organizes the annual MENACIS conference (since 2018) focusing on IS research in the MENA region. Sometimes held jointly with MCIS.

title: AISSAC — Southern African Chapter of AIS
description: AIS chapter serving the Southern African IS community with networking, knowledge exchange, and support for internationalization of local IS research. Includes a student chapter and strategic alliances with AIS Region 2 chapters.

title: CACAIS — Central Africa Chapter of AIS
description: AIS chapter for Central Africa organizing annual conferences bringing together IS researchers from the region and worldwide. Provides networking opportunities for doctoral students with top IS scholars.

title: CLEI — Latin American Conference on Informatics
description: Annual conference since 1974 organized by the Latin American Center for Informatics Studies. Dedicated Computer Education track. Papers in Spanish, Portuguese, or English. IFIP member. The largest Latin American computing conference.

title: SBSI — Brazilian Symposium on Information Systems
description: Annual meeting of the Brazilian IS community since 2004, organized under SBC (Brazilian Computer Society). Proceedings in ACM Digital Library. Covers contemporary IS topics bringing together students, researchers, professionals, and government.

title: Markkula Center for Applied Ethics — Technology Ethics Resources
description: Free teaching cases, modules, and frameworks for technology ethics education. Dedicated modules on cybersecurity ethics, software engineering ethics, online privacy, and AI ethics. Template for writing tech ethics case studies included.

title: IEEE TechEthics
description: Articles, reports, educational modules, and codes of ethics for emerging technologies. Includes the IEEE Student Ethics Competition toolkit with hypothetical case studies, judging forms, and promotional templates for campus events.

title: IDEO Design Thinking for Educators Toolkit
description: Free downloadable toolkit and workbook with design thinking process, methods, and real-world classroom examples. Available in 8 languages (Arabic, Chinese, French, German, Korean, Portuguese, Spanish, English).

title: Stanford d.school Design Thinking Bootleg
description: Free compendium of design thinking tools organized around empathize, define, ideate, prototype, and test modes. Available in English, Spanish, and German. Includes d.school Starter Kit (3-hour online intro) for educators.

title: Interaction Design Foundation (IxDF) — UX Design Courses
description: 130,000+ graduates across 40 graduate-level UX/HCI courses covering design thinking, user research, usability testing, and information architecture. Free open-access textbooks and encyclopedia. Affordable subscription ($16/mo).

title: TOGAF Standard & ArchiMate (The Open Group)
description: Industry-standard enterprise architecture framework (TOGAF) and modeling language (ArchiMate). Free ArchiMate specification and Archi freeware modeling tool. Certification paths from short credentials (3hrs) to multi-day courses.

title: NSF CyberAICorps Scholarship for Service (CyberAI SFS)
description: Up to $2.5M grants for institutions to provide cybersecurity/AI scholarships (up to 3 years per student). Innovation Track ($500K) supports curriculum enhancement. Students serve in government cybersecurity roles post-graduation.

title: NSF IUSE: EDU — Improving Undergraduate STEM Education
description: ~$61M/year for novel approaches to STEM teaching and learning, including computing and IS. Two tracks: Engaged Student Learning and Institutional/Community Transformation. Awards from $200K-$2M+ depending on level.

title: NSF IUSE: CUE — Computing in Undergraduate Education
description: NSF program specifically for re-envisioning computing education with emphasis on broadening participation, modernizing curricula (AI, quantum), integrating privacy/security/society, and cross-disciplinary computing.

title: Erasmus+ Digital Education Funding (Forward-Looking Projects)
description: EU funding for transnational digital education projects including AI in education, digital skills assessment (DigComp), and data literacy. Total budget EUR 32M for 2025 call. Up to EUR 1M per project for AI public-private partnerships.

title: AACSB Academy — AI & Technology Workshops for Faculty
description: Professional development for business school faculty including intensive AI integration workshops, on-campus customized training, and the ICAM conference (1,200+ educators from 60+ countries). Covers teaching, accreditation, and digital literacy.

title: Valacich & Schneider — Information Systems Today (Pearson)
description: 9th edition covering digital density, API economy, cloud, social media, AI, and IoT. MyLab MIS companion with test banks, PowerPoints, instructor manuals, and student data files. Real-world company cases in every chapter.

title: Rainer & Prince — Introduction to Information Systems (Wiley/WileyPLUS)
description: 10th edition with WileyPLUS companion featuring lecture videos, Bloomberg real-world video activities, ethics cases, and Data Analysis Bootcamps for Excel, Tableau, Power BI, Alteryx, and SQL.

title: Agile Education Program (Scrum Inc.)
description: Founded by Scrum co-creator Jeff Sutherland. Provides Scrum Inc Agile credentials and Scrum@Scale framework training. ScrumLab online learning platform for students and organizations pursuing agile transformation.

title: CyberCorps Scholarship for Service Portal (OPM)
description: Central portal for the SFS program managed by the Office of Personnel Management. Students can find participating institutions, scholarship details, and government job placement opportunities. Connects graduates with federal cybersecurity roles.

title: HKAIS — Hong Kong Association for Information Systems
description: AIS chapter for Hong Kong's IS academic community. All IS groups in Hong Kong universities are located in business schools. Active in promoting IS research and education across Hong Kong's higher education institutions.

title: SAP Signavio Academic Models (SAP-SAM) Dataset
description: Open dataset of hundreds of thousands of business process models created over a decade by the BPM Academic Initiative. Available on Zenodo for research on process mining, BPM, and AI applications.

title: Wirtschaftsinformatik.de — German IS Community Portal
description: Central portal for the German-speaking Wirtschaftsinformatik (IS) community with conference listings, research information, and community resources. Gateway to WKWI and GI Fachbereich WI activities.

title: Markkula Center — Ethics in Technology Practice Toolkit
description: Compendium for embedding ethics into computing curricula: ethical decision-making frameworks, case studies on AI/VR/privacy, cybersecurity ethics modules, software engineering ethics modules, and a toolkit for integrating ethics into product development.

title: DataCamp — Data Analyst in Power BI Track
description: Co-created with Microsoft, this track covers Power BI from beginner to PL-300 certification prep. Includes hands-on projects, a 50% PL-300 exam discount, and integration with classroom-based data analytics courses.

title: ACIS — Australasian Conference on Information Systems
description: Premier IS conference for Australia and New Zealand, held annually since 1990. Covers technical, organizational, business, and social issues in IT. Proceedings on AISeL. ACIS 2025 theme: 'The State of the IS Discipline.'

title: IEEE-CS/ACM Code of Ethics for Software Engineers
description: Joint IEEE Computer Society and ACM code of ethics for software engineering professionals. Serves an educational function for teaching professional responsibility, ethical obligations, and standards in IS/CS courses.

title: SAP Signavio Research Alliance
description: Research visits for PhD candidates and postdocs (3-6 months, on SAP payroll). Focus areas: process mining, computer science, and AI in BPM. Enables practice-oriented academic research in collaboration with SAP engineers.

title: AACSB Innovations That Inspire
description: 10-year program recognizing innovative business schools worldwide. Showcases examples of technology integration, entrepreneurship, and social innovation in business education that can inspire IS curriculum design.

title: European Digital Education Hub
description: EU platform connecting national authorities, private sector, researchers, and educators around digital education. Facilitates exchange of good practices, co-creation, and policy development in digital skills and education.

title: Celonis STaR Program (Student Thesis and Research)
description: Free Celonis software, learning resources, Academy access, badges, and certifications for students writing theses, seminar papers, or capstone projects on process intelligence and process mining.

title: IEEE TEMS Educational Materials Portal
description: IEEE Technology and Engineering Management Society's curated collection of educational materials including articles, podcasts, and past ITMC conference papers on technology and engineering management.

title: IEEE TEMS Education Committee
description: IEEE TEMS's dedicated education committee overseeing IoT & AI challenges, industry forums, online courses and webinars, and global student competitions relevant to technology management education.

title: IEEE TEMS Body of Knowledge (TEMSBOK)
description: Comprehensive body of knowledge covering technology and engineering management topics including business analysis, innovation, entrepreneurship, project management, and IT governance. Published by Wiley/IEEE Press.

title: IEEE Transactions on Engineering Management
description: Premier IEEE journal for researchers, practitioners, educators, and graduate students in engineering, technology, and innovation management. Covers IS-relevant topics like IT project management and digital transformation.

title: IEEE TechEthics Education Modules
description: Free educational modules on technology ethics including privacy foundations, transparency in systems, responsible innovation, ethical AI design, and data protection. Directly applicable to IS ethics courses.

title: IEEE Digital Privacy Education Portal
description: Comprehensive digital privacy education hub offering courses, curriculum development resources, and the 'Digital Privacy: Principles, Regulations, and Ethics' program. Includes collaboration with ACM on privacy curriculum guidelines for universities.

title: IEEE Digital Privacy Curriculum Development Initiative
description: Joint ACM/IEEE-CS/IFIP initiative developing privacy curricular guidelines for university graduate programs, defining knowledge areas including privacy-preserving software engineering and information systems/technology.

title: IEEE Systems, Man, and Cybernetics Society (SMCS)
description: IEEE society advancing theory and application in systems science, human-machine systems, and cybernetics. Covers sociotechnical systems, organizational interactions, cognitive ergonomics, and computational social systems highly relevant to IS.

title: IEEE Professional Communication Society (ProComm)
description: IEEE society for engineers, technical communicators, and educators focused on improving professional communication. Offers resources on visuals, interpersonal communication, team communication, and written reporting relevant to IS communication courses.

title: IEEE CertifAIEd AI Ethics Professional Certification
description: Professional certification program for AI ethics, teaching how to apply IEEE's ethical framework covering accountability, transparency, algorithmic bias, and privacy to AI systems. Applicable to IS students and practitioners.

title: IEEE Ethically Aligned Design (EAD) Framework
description: Comprehensive vision for ethical development of autonomous and intelligent systems, with educational resources and the P7000 standards series. Covers AI governance, privacy, bias, and transparency relevant to IS ethics education.

title: IEEE P7000 Series — Ethics Standards for AI and Autonomous Systems
description: Collection of IEEE standards translating ethical principles into technical requirements, including algorithmic bias (P7003), child/student data governance (P7004), data privacy (P7002), and AI transparency (P7001). Essential reference for IS courses on AI governance.

title: IEEE Internet of Things (IoT) Education Resources
description: Central hub for IoT education including courses, distinguished lecturer program, and resource center. Covers IoT for business, systems design, and technology management relevant to IS curricula.

title: IEEE Xplore Digital Library
description: World's largest technical research database with over 7 million documents including journals, conferences, and standards. Contains IS-relevant content on information systems, human-computer interaction, and technology management. Fully open access for ACM/IEEE publications as of 2026.

title: IEEE Xplore Online Courses
description: Over 500 online courses on IEEE Xplore covering AI, cybersecurity, IoT, blockchain, ethics, and technology management. Provides CEUs and PDHs for professional development.

title: IEEE eLearning Library
description: Peer-reviewed online course library with hundreds of course hours in core and emerging technologies. Supports flipped classrooms, project-based learning, and ABET criteria. Includes AI for business managers and ethical AI courses.

title: ACM SIGMIS — Special Interest Group on Management Information Systems
description: ACM's most IS-relevant SIG, promoting research and best practice in management of information systems. Sponsors IS curriculum development, the CPR conference, ICIS doctoral awards, and publishes The Data Base for Advances in Information Systems.

title: ACM SIGMIS CPR Conference (Computers and People Research)
description: Annual conference on IT workforce development, education, training, employment, leadership, and management. Includes doctoral consortium and Magid Igbaria Outstanding Paper Award. Proceedings published by ACM.

title: The Data Base for Advances in Information Systems (ACM SIGMIS DATABASE)
description: Peer-reviewed quarterly journal published since 1969, one of the longest-running IS publications. Covers management of IS, electronic commerce, data management, HCI, and software engineering. Now open access via ACM Digital Library.

title: ACM Interactions Magazine
description: Bimonthly ACM magazine bridging HCI research and UX practice, covering interaction design, user experience, and service design. Features an HCI Education forum with curricula and pedagogy resources relevant to IS design courses.

title: ACM Queue — Magazine for Practicing Software Engineers
description: ACM's practitioner-focused magazine bridging academic and industrial computing. Features 'Research for Practice' guides, case studies, and articles on real-world technology challenges. Free and open access as of 2026.

title: ACM Code of Ethics and Professional Conduct
description: The conscience of the computing profession, with companion case studies, the CARE ethical decision framework, and a downloadable booklet with classroom activities. Essential teaching resource for IS ethics courses.

title: ACM Code of Ethics — Using the Code (Teaching Resources)
description: Practical guide for educators on integrating the ACM Code of Ethics into computing courses. Includes the CARE framework (Consider, Analyze, Review, Evaluate), case studies demonstrating ethical principles, and classroom activity suggestions.

title: ACM Transactions on Management Information Systems (TMIS)
description: Premier ACM journal for MIS research covering design, development, assessment, and management of IT in organizations. Welcomes design science, analytical modeling, and system-oriented IS research. Open access via ACM Digital Library.

title: ACM SIGCHI Education Resources and Living Curriculum
description: SIGCHI Education Committee's initiatives including a living HCI curriculum, open educational resources via EngageCSEdu, the EduCHI community of practice, and surveys on global HCI education needs. Directly relevant to IS UX/design courses.

title: ACM-W — Women in Computing
description: ACM council supporting women in computing with 36,000+ members. Offers scholarships for conference attendance, celebration events, student chapters, and monthly newsletters. Valuable resource for IS diversity and inclusion teaching.

title: ACM Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Resources
description: ACM's DEI council offering best practices for broadening participation in computing, including resources for conferences, organizations, and educational programs. Relevant for IS programs focused on inclusive technology design.

title: ACM EngageCSEdu — Open Educational Resources for Computing
description: Peer-reviewed repository of engaging, classroom-tested OERs for computing education. Includes special issues on AI/ML, responsible computing, and ethics. All resources are designed with diversity and inclusion engagement practices.

title: ACM EngageCSEdu — Ethics and Computing Collection
description: Open access collection of ethics and computing educational resources curated by the ACM Task Force on Ethics and Computing Education. Categorized articles and teaching materials for embedding ethics across IS/CS courses.

title: ACM SIGMOD — Education Resources for Data Management
description: ACM SIG on Management of Data offering educational resources including tutorial videos, conference tutorials on cutting-edge data topics, and teaching tools for database education. Relevant to IS data management courses.

title: ACM Computing Surveys
description: Highest-ranked computer science journal (Impact Factor 23.8) publishing comprehensive survey articles across all computing fields including information systems, HCI, AI, and data science. Fully open access as of 2026.

title: ACM Digital Library
description: World's most comprehensive database of computing and IT literature. Now available in Basic (free open access) and Premium editions as of 2026. Contains full ACM publication archive including IS, HCI, and computing education content.

title: ACM Education Resources Hub
description: Central hub for ACM's education initiatives including curriculum recommendations, EngageCSEdu, education policy, and resources for educators at all levels. Covers computing education from K-12 through graduate programs.

title: AOM TIM Division — Technology & Innovation Management
description: AOM division with 4,300+ members studying innovation, R&D management, and technological change. Offers doctoral/junior/mid-career faculty consortia, distinguished scholar awards, and workshops on AI, digital transformation, and emerging technologies.

title: Academy of Management Learning & Education (AMLE) — Teaching Resources
description: AMLE journal's collection of teaching slides based on published research articles, freely available for management educators to adopt in their classes. Covers IS-relevant topics across management education.

title: Academy of Management Learning & Education (AMLE) Journal
description: Premier journal for management learning and education research (Impact Factor 5.2). Publishes theory, empirical research, and teaching resources on management education in universities, businesses, and organizations.

title: AOM STR Division — Strategic Management Teaching Resources
description: Comprehensive teaching resource library including strategy simulations directory, best-selling case lists, sample syllabi, PDW recordings on YouTube, in-class exercises, and resources for online teaching. Highly relevant to IS strategy courses.

title: AOM STR Division — Strategy Simulations Directory
description: Curated directory of strategy simulation products and platforms for management education, gathered from simulation companies' websites. Useful for IS courses incorporating strategic IT decision-making simulations.

title: AOM SIM Division — Social Issues in Management Teaching Resources
description: Teaching resources for social issues in management including textbooks/syllabi, class activities, and PDW presentations. Covers business ethics, sustainability, stakeholder management, and technology ethics relevant to IS.

title: AOM AMR Teaching Resources
description: Academy of Management Review's teaching resources page providing materials derived from published AMR articles, adaptable for management and IS classroom use.

title: IEEE Computer Society Resource Library
description: Curated collection of computing and engineering resources organized by technical domain, including career guides, curricula recommendations (CC2020, CS2023), conference reports, and technology insights.

title: ACM SIGMIS Curriculum Development for IS Education
description: SIGMIS represents ACM in developing model curricula for IS education at undergraduate and graduate levels. Partners with AIS on IS curriculum standards and hosts the ICIS Doctoral Dissertation Paper Award.

title: IEEE IoT Resource Center
description: Centralized platform for IoT technical resources, videos, documents, and professional development materials. Supports IS courses covering IoT strategy, digital transformation, and smart systems.

title: IEEE Transactions on Human-Machine Systems
description: IEEE journal covering human-machine interaction, organizational systems, cognitive ergonomics, and human information processing. Directly relevant to IS research on sociotechnical systems and user-system interaction.

title: WKWI Rahmenempfehlung für Wirtschaftsinformatik-Studiengänge
description: Framework curriculum recommendation (v1.3, 2025) for Information Systems (Wirtschaftsinformatik) degree programs at German universities. Published jointly by GI, WKWI (VHB), and WI e.V. Covers 16 content areas including AI, digital transformation, process management, and data analytics. Includes models for Bachelor/Master programs in WI, BWL, and Informatik.

title: Stanford HAI — Teaching with AI Resources
description: Stanford Human-Centered AI Institute resources on responsible AI education, including course materials, policy briefs, and teaching strategies for AI integration.

title: Google AI for Anyone / AI Essentials
description: Free AI literacy and hands-on AI courses from Google. Includes TensorFlow tutorials, Responsible AI toolkit, and courses suitable for non-CS students.

title: Elements of AI (University of Helsinki & MinnaLearn)
description: Free online course introducing AI concepts to non-technical audiences. Available in 25+ languages. Over 1 million registered learners. Ideal for IS students as AI literacy module.

title: ABET Computing Accreditation Commission (CAC) Criteria
description: Accreditation criteria for computing programs including IS, IT, CS, cybersecurity, and data science. Updated annually with IS-specific program criteria.

title: AACSB International — Accreditation Standards for Business Schools
description: Global accreditation body for business schools. Many IS programs are housed in AACSB-accredited schools. Standards cover curriculum, faculty qualifications, and assurance of learning.

title: EQUIS — EFMD Quality Improvement System
description: European-origin international accreditation for business schools. Emphasizes internationalization and corporate connections. Relevant for IS programs in European institutions.

title: INSEAD Case Publishing — Technology & Digital Transformation Cases
description: European case publisher with strong focus on digital transformation, platform business models, AI strategy, and technology management. Global perspective.

title: Stanford Graduate School of Business — Free Cases
description: Selected free teaching cases from Stanford GSB covering technology, entrepreneurship, and innovation. Includes Silicon Valley ecosystem cases.

title: DigComp 2.2 — European Digital Competence Framework
description: EU reference framework for digital competencies with 5 areas and 21 competences. Widely used in European IS curriculum design and digital literacy assessment.

title: e-CF — European e-Competence Framework for ICT Professionals
description: European standard (EN 16234-1) defining 41 ICT competences. Used by employers and educators across Europe for workforce and curriculum alignment.

title: SFIA — Skills Framework for the Information Age
description: Global framework describing digital skills and competencies at 7 levels of responsibility. Used in over 200 countries for curriculum mapping, workforce planning, and professional development.

title: SANS Cyber Ranges & CyberStart (Free for Academic Partners)
description: Hands-on cybersecurity training environments from SANS Institute. CyberStart program offers free resources to identify and nurture cybersecurity talent in universities.

title: NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF 2.0)
description: Widely adopted cybersecurity risk management framework. Version 2.0 (2024) adds governance function. Essential reference for teaching IT governance and cybersecurity management.

title: Snowflake for Academia
description: Free cloud data platform access and training for educators and students. Includes certifications, curriculum materials, and hands-on labs for data engineering and analytics.

title: Databricks Academy & Higher Education Solutions
description: Training and certification for data engineering, data science, and ML on the lakehouse platform. Solution accelerators for education include cybersecurity and personalized learning.

title: DataCamp for Classrooms
description: Free access for academic institutions offering interactive courses in Python, R, SQL, and data science. Includes custom assignments and progress tracking.

title: Tableau Public — Free Data Visualization Platform & Sample Datasets
description: Free data visualization platform. Includes curated datasets for health, climate, government, and social topics suitable for classroom assignments and student portfolios.

title: Google BigQuery Sandbox — Free Data Warehouse for Teaching
description: Free access to Google BigQuery with 1 TB/month query processing and 10 GB storage. No credit card needed — ideal for SQL and data analytics classes.

title: FiveThirtyEight Data — Open Datasets for Data Journalism
description: Clean, well-documented datasets used in FiveThirtyEight articles on politics, sports, science, and culture. Excellent for classroom data analysis exercises.

title: Data.gov — U.S. Government Open Data
description: Over 290,000 federal datasets covering education, health, finance, climate, and more. Excellent for teaching data wrangling and analytics with real-world public sector data.

title: EU Open Data Portal
description: Central portal for datasets from EU institutions, agencies, and member states. Covers economy, environment, transport, and health. Multilingual interface.

title: UCI Machine Learning Repository
description: Over 600 curated datasets for machine learning, categorized by task (classification, regression, clustering) and domain. Widely used in academic research and teaching.

title: AI Ethics Lab — Teaching AI Ethics Resources
description: Case studies, discussion guides, and workshop materials for teaching AI ethics. Covers bias, fairness, accountability, transparency, and the societal impact of AI systems.

title: Responsible AI Institute
description: Frameworks, certifications, and toolkits for responsible AI governance. Includes educational materials on AI risk assessment and conformity standards.

title: Education and Information Technologies (Springer)
description: Peer-reviewed journal on the application of information and communication technologies in education. Covers learning analytics, blended learning, and educational data mining.

title: Computers & Education (Elsevier)
description: High-impact journal covering the use of computing in education. Topics include AI in education, learning analytics, MOOC effectiveness, and digital literacy.

title: Mendix University Program & Academy
description: Free low-code platform licenses, certification exams, and curriculum resources for 100+ universities worldwide. Includes learning paths from Rapid to Expert Developer.

title: OutSystems Training & Education
description: Full-stack low-code platform with free personal environment and training courses. Covers web, mobile, and reactive app development.

title: Appian Academic Program
description: Process automation-focused low-code platform with academic access. Covers BPM, RPA, and AI-powered workflow automation.

title: Microsoft Power Platform for Education (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI)
description: Low-code development suite from Microsoft. Power Apps for app building, Power Automate for workflows, and Power BI for analytics. Free for students with .edu accounts.

title: Awesome Public Datasets (GitHub)
description: Community-curated list of high-quality open datasets organized by topic (agriculture, biology, economics, government, machine learning, transportation, etc.).

title: CORGIS Datasets Project
description: 40+ curated datasets for introductory programming and data analysis in Python, Java, and Racket. Domains include education, politics, medicine, and history.

title: IFIP TC8 — Information Systems Technical Committee
description: International Federation for Information Processing technical committee on IS. Working groups cover design science, IS in organizations, smart cities, and IS education.

title: POD Network — Professional & Organizational Development Network in Higher Education
description: Resources for faculty development in higher education, including teaching improvement strategies, course design, and assessment methods relevant for IS educators.

title: K-AIS — Korean Association for Information Systems
description: Korean chapter of AIS promoting IS education and research in South Korea. Hosts the Korean Conference on Information Systems.

title: JASMIN — Japan Society for Management Information
description: Japanese IS research community promoting information systems education and research. Publishes research and hosts annual conferences.

title: SSRN — Social Science Research Network (IS eJournals)
description: Working paper repository widely used by IS researchers. Includes dedicated IS, eCommerce, and innovation eJournals. Free to download most papers.

title: HBR Simulations & Experiential Learning
description: Interactive simulations for IT strategy, digital disruption, cybersecurity, data analytics, and change management. Includes instructor guides and debrief materials.

title: Hacking Lab — Cybersecurity Training Labs
description: Online ethical hacking lab environment with CTF challenges and tutorials. Free for academic use. Covers web application security, network attacks, and forensics.

title: TryHackMe — Cybersecurity Learning Platform
description: Gamified cybersecurity learning with browser-based labs. Learning paths for beginners to advanced. Free tier available; educational discounts for institutions.

title: Camunda Academic Program (BPM & Process Orchestration)
description: Open-source process orchestration platform. Free academic licenses for teaching BPMN execution, workflow automation, and microservices orchestration.

title: UiPath Academic Alliance (RPA Education)
description: Free RPA software, curriculum, and certifications for universities. Teaching resources for robotic process automation, AI-powered automation, and process mining.

title: ServiceNow Academic Program (NextGen Professionals)
description: Free platform access, training, and certifications for students and educators. Covers IT service management, workflow automation, and digital transformation.

title: Atlassian Education Program (Jira, Confluence)
description: Free Atlassian Cloud for educators and students. Includes Jira for agile project management and Confluence for team collaboration — essential tools for IS project courses.

title: Figma for Education
description: Free professional plan for students and educators. Industry-standard tool for UI/UX design, prototyping, and collaborative design thinking exercises.

title: Notion for Education
description: Free Plus plan for students and educators. Versatile workspace for knowledge management, project documentation, and collaborative coursework.
